name: Permanent Residence Status

requirement_groups.name: 3 years' residence plus means and housing

requirements.blocker_text: 3 years of (temporary) residence in Armenia, plus a means of living and a place to live in the Republic of Armenia.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of legal temporary residence in Armenia.

requirements.blocker_text: Having a relative who is a citizen of the Republic of Armenia can qualify for permanent residence without the standalone 3-year wait.
Persons of Armenian descent, or those running a long-term business in Armenia, may qualify for permanent residence status directly.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 3 years' legal residence (standard route)
Proof of means of living and housing in Armenia
Proof of RA-citizen relative, Armenian descent, or business activity (alternative routes)

outcome.duration_length: 5 years, renewable for the same period each time

sources.title: Armenian Lawyer -- permanent residence status (5 years, renewable): grounds include RA-citizen relatives, means/housing after 3 years, Armenian descent, or long-term entrepreneurship
Migration and Citizenship Service -- confirms permanent residence status document, 5-year duration, renewable, in-person application, but does not itself detail qualifying grounds

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Armenia). STATUS: DRAFT -- the 5-year duration and card/application mechanics are tier-1 confirmed, but the specific qualifying grounds (which this file's hard requirements describe) come only from a tier-3 legal guide, since the tier-1 migration.mia.gov.am summary page did not itself break down eligibility criteria. citizenship_after_months modeled 0 since permanent residence status holders are not described as needing an additional fixed wait beyond meeting am_naturalisation.json's own 3-year residence and language conditions -- the two clocks are not modeled as stacking. This status is distinct from am_special_residence_armenian_origin.json's 10-year special-passport status, which serves a narrower diaspora-specific population and carries different rights (see that file's notes).
